desc.en: As it is already said that some days are more related to Imam Reza (a) on which visiting the shrine of Imam Reza (a) bears excessive merits. On the basis of some famous traditions, Imam Reza (a) was born on eleven Zilqad Birth Of Imam Reza (a). Emaad al-Deen Tabari, in his book ‘Bashaarat al-Mustufa’ writes that Hesham Ibn Ahmad narrates on the authority of Imam Moosa Kazim (a) that he (a) said…

arabic.text: هَلْ عَلِمْتَ اَحَدًا مِنْ اَهْلِ الْمَغْرِبِ قَدِمَ؟

lines.rarabic: HAL A’LIM-TA AHA-DAN MIN AHLIL MAGHRE-BE QADEM?

trans.en: Do you know anyone from the West who has come here?
trans.rurdu: Kya tum koi aise ko jaante ho jo maghrib (West) ki jaanib se yahan aaya ho?
trans.urdu: کیا تم کوئی ایسے کو جانتے ہو جو مغرب کی جانب سے یہاں آیا ہو؟

desc.en: I said, “No.” Imam Kazim (a) said, “Yes, a red man has come here. Let’s go to see him together.” We mounted our horses and rode over to see him. He was a Western man with several slaves. Imam Kazim (a) said, “Show us your slaves.” The man showed the Imam (a) nine of his female slaves. About each one of them Imam Kazim (a) said, “I do not need her.”

Then he said, “Show us the rest of them.” The man said, “I do not have anymore.” The Imam (a) said, “Yes you do. Show them to us.” The man swore to Allah and said, “I swear by Allah that I do not have anymore. There is just an ill female slave left.” The Imam (a) said, “What would happen if you also show her to us?” The man refused and then the Imam (a) left.

The next day Imam Kazim (a) sent me to that man, instructed me to ask him what the last price was for her and to accept whatever price he quoted for her. Then I went to see that man. He said, “I will not sell her for an amount less than so much.” I said, “Okay. I accept the amount. Here is the money. It is yours.” He said, “Okay. That female slave is ours. But please tell me who the man with you was.”

I said, “He is from the Hashemite tribe.” He asked, “Which branch?” I answered, “He is from the noble men of the Hashemite tribe.” The man said, “Please explain more.” I said, “I do not know any more than this.” Then the man said, “Okay. Let me tell you then. I bought this female slave from one of the farthest towns away in the West.” A woman from the People of the Book saw me and asked me, “What is this female slave doing with you?”

I said, “I have bought her for myself.” She said, “It is neither proper nor possible for her to be with people like you. She must live with the best of the people on the Earth. She will give birth to a child after living in their house for a short while to whom all the people of the East and the West will be humble.” Hisham said, “After buying her, I took her to Imam Kazim (a). Then after a short while, she gave birth to (Imam) Ali ibn Moosa Reza (a)

Shaikh Mufeed reports that Almighty Allah revealed Torah on Hazrat Moosa (a) and in the year 201 A.H. oath of allegiance was taken for Imam Ali Ibn Moosa Reza (a). This is an auspicious and pleasant day which is a day of renewal of faith for the believers. It is desirable to thank the Alnighty Allah by giving charity to the poors and needy persons, by manifesting the right of the pure progeny of Muhammad (a) and degrading the hypocrites. My master Imam Reza (a) was martyred on 30th of Zilqad 203 A.H. in the land of Toos. Historians have mentioned some other dates of the martyrdom of Imam Reza (a). It is written in the book ‘Irshad’ that Imam (a) was martyred in the month of Safar in the year 203 A.H. In the book ‘Kafi’, ‘Durr’ and ‘Ateeq’ same dates are mentioned. In the book ‘Mawaalid al-Aimmah (a)’, the year of martyrdom is given 202 A.H. And it is written in the book ‘Manaqib’ that Imam (a) was martyred during the last six days of the month of Ramazan. In the book ‘Durr’ it is said that Ma’moon martyred Imam Reza (a) by giving poison in the grapes on Friday the 1st of the month of Ramazan 202 A.H. in Toos. The date of martyrdom of Imam (a) is also mentioned as 14th and 21st of the month of Ramazan.

title.en: Visiting the Shrine of Imam Reza (a) On 23rd Zilqad
title.rurdu: 23rd Zilqad ko Imam Reza (a) ke Rauze par jaana
title.urdu: ۲۳؍ذیقعد کو امام رضاؑ کے روضہ پر جانا

desc.en: Allamah Majlisi (r) reports on the authority of Sayed ibne Taaoos (r) who said that I have seen in some of the books written by Shia scholars that they narrated: “It is desirable to recite any Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) from far or near on 23rd Zilqad.”
desc.rurdu: Allamah Majlisi (r) ne Sayed Ibne Taaoos (r) se riwaayat ki hai keh unho’n ne farmaya: Mai ne kuchh kitaabo’n mein dekha jo Shia ulma se hai: 23rd Zilqaad ko Imam Reza (a) ki koi bhi ziyarat dur ya nazdik se padhna laazim hai.
desc.urdu: علامہ مجلسی نے سید ابن طاؤس سے روایت کی ہے کہ اُنہوں نے فرمایا: میں نے کچھ کتابوں میں دیکھا جو شیعہ علماء سے ہے: ۲۳؍ماہِ ذی القاد کو امام رضاؑ کی کوئی بھی زیارت دور یا نزدیک سے پڑھنا لازم ہے۔

desc.en: Hasan ibn Ali Washshaa reports: “When I was young I got the prestige of being in the presence of Imam Reza (a) accompanied by my father on the 25th of Zilqad and had the honour to dine with him. Imam (a) said to my father: “On the night of 25th of Zilqad, Prophet Ibrahim (a) and Prophet Isa (a) were born. In this night the earth had been spread on the water from under the Holy Ka’bah. It is highly desirable to observe fast on this day the reward of it is as the person has observed fast for sixty months.”
desc.rurdu: Hasan Ibne Ali Washshaa ne riwaayat ki hai: Jab mai jawaan tha tab mujhe apne baba ke saath Imam Reza (a) ki khidmat mein haazir hone ka mauka mila aur Imam (a) ke saath dastar khwaan par baiyth-ne ka sharaf bhi haasil huwa. Imam (a) ne mere waalid ko farmaya: 25th Zilqad ki shab mein Paighambar Ibrahim (a) aur Eesa (a) ki wilaadat huwi thi. Isi shab mein Kaabe ke neeche se zameen ko paani par bichhaaya gaya tha. Bohot ziyadah taakeed hai keh is din roza rakkhe aur is din ke roze ka sawaab 60 mahino ke rozo’n ka sawaab ke bara-bar hai.
desc.urdu: حسن ابن علی وشاع نے روایت کی ہے: جب میں جوان تھا تب مجھے اپنے بابا کے ساتھ امام رضاؑ کی خدمت میں حاضر ہونے کا موقع ملا اور امامؑ کے ساتھ دستر خوان پر بیٹھنے  کا شرف بھی حاصل ہوا۔ امامؑ نے میرے والد کو فرمایا: ۲۵؍ماہِ ذیقعد کی شب میں پیغمبر ابراہیمؑ اور عیسیؑ کی ولادت ہوئی تھی۔ اسی شب میں کعبہ کے نیچے سے زمین کو پانی پر بچھایا گیا تھا۔ بہت زیادہ تاکید ہے کہ اس دن روزہ رکھے اور اس دن کے روزے کا ثواب ۶۰ مہینوں کے روزوں کے ثواب کے برابر ہے۔

desc.en: It is narrated that on 19th of Zilqad the Almighty Allah got the Holy Ka’abah down on the earth and this was the first blessing descended on the earth. Whoever observes fast on this day it would be expiation of his sins committed in sixty years. Allamah Majlisi (r) in his book ‘Muntahi al-Matlab’ reports that Shaikh Kulaini (r) in his book ‘Kaafi’ and Shaikh Toosi (r) in ‘Tahzeeb’ has narrated on the authority of Imam Reza (a) who said: “Almighty Allah established the Holy Ka’bah on 25th Zilqad and this was the first blessing descended on the earth. The Almighty Allah declared it a shelter and place of peace and tranquility for the people. Observing of fast on this day is worth fasting for sixty months in any other month.
desc.rurdu: Riwaayat mein hai keh 19th Zilqad ko Allah (swt) ne Khaana’e Kaaba ko zameen par utaara aur yeh zameen par Uski pehli ne’mat thi. Jo koi is din roza rakkhega to uske 60 saal ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge. Allamah Majlisi (r) apni kitaab Muntahi Al-Matlab mein naql kiya hai keh Shaikh Kulaini (r) apni kitaab Kaafi aur Shaikh Toosi (r) apni kitaab Tahzeeb mein Imam Reza (a) se riwaayat ki hai keh Imam (a) ne farmaya: 25th Zilqaad ko Allah (swt) ne Khaana’e Kaaba ko zameen par qaaem (establish) kiya aur yeh woh pehli ne’mat thi jo zameen par naazil huwi. Allah (swt) ne Khaana’e Kaaba ki zameen ko insaano ke liye amn o sukoon ki jagah qaraar di. Is din roza rakhna digar mahino mein 60 mahino ke rozo’n ke bara-bar hai.
desc.urdu: روایت میں ہے کہ ۱۹؍ماہِ ذیقعد کو اللہ تعالی نے خانہ کعبہ کو زمین پر اُتارا اور یہ زمین پر اُس کی پہلی نعمت تھی۔ جو کوئی اس دن روزہ رکھےگا تو اُس کے ۶۰ سال کے گناہ بخش دیئے جائنگے۔ علامہ مجلسی اپنی کتاب منتہی المتلب میں نقل کیا ہے کہ شیخ کلینی اپنی کتاب کافی اور شیخ طوسی اپنی کتاب تہذیب میں امام رضاؑ سے روایت کی ہے کہ امامؑ نے فرمایا: ۲۵؍ماہِ ذی القاد کو اللہ تعالا نے  خانہ کعبہ کو زمین پر قائم کیا اور یہ وہ پہلی نعمت تھی جو زمین پر نازل ہوئی۔ اللہ تعالی نے خانہ کعبہ کی زمین کو انسانوں کے لئے امن و سکون کی جگہ قرار دی۔ اس دن روزہ رکھنا دگر مہینوں میں ۶۰ مہینوں کے روزوں کے برابر ہے۔

title.en: Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) on 25th Zilqad
title.rurdu: 25th Zilqad ko Imam Reza (a) ki Ziyarat

desc.en: Mir Daamaad writes in the magazine ‘Arba-a’h Ayyaam’: On this day visting the shrine of Imam Reza (a) is one of the highly rewarding acts and emphatically and peremptory desirable act. In the same way visiting the shrine of Imam Reza (a) on 1st of Rajab is also highly recommended. Shaikh Sadooq (r) in his book ‘Man laa Yahzorohu al-Faqeeh’ reports that the boat of Prophet Noah (a) was settled down on ‘Joodi’ on 1st of Rajab.

It is one of the most illustrious and August days but it is not amongst the Ayyaam’e Arba (four special days). But according to some persons the boat of Prophet Noah (a) was settled down on 25th of Zilqad which is one of the four (special) days and the Day of Dahwul Arz. The obligatory acts of whoever performs the visitation of the shrine of Imam Reza (a), despite the far distance are: 1) Have a ritual bath of Dahwul Arz. 2) Have a ritual bath of Ziyarat with the intention, ‘I take the bath on this day of Dahwul Arz from distance and the bath for the visitation of the shrine of Imam Reza (a) seeking proximity to Almighty Allah. 3) In Arabic the intenton (niyyat) will be like this…

arabic.text: اَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلَ زِيَارَةِ اَبِیْ الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْبُعْدِ فِیْ یَوْمِ دَحْوُ الْاَرْضِ لِنَدْبَہٗ قُرْبَةً اِلَى اللهِ۔

lines.rarabic: AGH-TASELO GHASLA ZEYAARATE ABIL HASANIR REZAA A’LAIY-HIS SALAAMO’ NIL BOA’DE FEE YAUME DAHWUL ARZE LE-NADBA-HU QURBATAN ELAL-LAAH.

trans.en: I perform the ritual bath for the Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) from distance on this day of Dahwul Arz to seek the proximity of Almighty Allah.
trans.rurdu: Mai ghusl karta hu Imam Reza (a) ki ziyarat ke liye dur se Dahwul Arz ke din Allah (swt) ki qurbat (nazdiki) haasil karne ke liye.
trans.urdu: میں غسل کرتا ہو امام رضاؑ کی زیارت کی غرض سے دحوالارض کے دن اللہ تعالی کی قربت حاصل کرنے کے لئے۔

desc.en: If somebody is in the shrine of any other infallible Imam (a) and wants to recite the Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) then he should give preference to Ziyarat over the Namaz of Ziyarat. In case one is not inside the shrine of any infallible Imam (a) then he should go out in the desert or go on the roof top of his house or under the sky or any high rise place where roof is not there, he should perform Namaz of Ziyarat first and then recite the Ziyarat. Perform 2 rakats namaz of Ziyarat. It is preferable to perform 6 rakats of prayers of Ziyarat or 4 rakats finishing with only one salaam. In Arabic it should be…

arabic.text: اُصَلِّیْ صَلَاۃُ زِیَارَۃ مَوْلَایَ الرِّضَا عَلَیْہِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْبُعْدِ فِیْ یَوْمِ دَحْوُ الْاَرْضِ لِنَدْبِہَا قُرْبَۃً اِلَی اللہِ۔

lines.rarabic: O-SALLEE SALAATO ZIYAARAT MAWLAA YAR REZAA A’LAIY-HIS SALAAMO A’NIL BO’DE FEE YAUME DAHWUL ARZE LE-NADBE-HAA QURBATAN ELAL-LAAH.

trans.en: I perform the Namaz of Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) from distance on this day of Dahwul Arz to seek the proximity of Almighty Allah.
trans.rurdu: Mai namaz’e ziyarat padhta hu Imam Reza (a) ki dur se Dahwul Arz ke din Allah (swt) ki qurbat (nazdiki) haasil karne ke liye.
trans.urdu: میں نماز زیارت پڑھتا ہو امام رضاؑ کی دورسے دحوالارض کے دن اللہ تعالی کی قربت حاصل کرنے کے لئے۔

desc.en: After finishing the prayer one should recite the Tasbeeh of Hazrat Fatema Zahra (s), keep the head in prostration and nose and forehead on the Turbah of Imam Hussain (a) and say…

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ هَدِيَّةٌ مِنِّيْ اِلٰى رُوْحِ سَيِّدِيْ وَاِمَامِيْ عَبْدِكَ وَوَلِيِّكَ اَبِيْ الْـحَسَنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوْسَی الرِّضَا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNA HAA-TAIY NIR RAK-A’TAIY-NE HADIYYA-TOON MINNEE ILAA ROOHE SAYYEDEE WA IMAAMEE A’B-DEKA WA WALIYYE-KA ABIL HASANE A’LIY-YIBNE MOOSAR REZA.

trans.en: O Allah! These 2 rakats of prayer are present from me to the soul of my master and my Imam, Your servant and Your friend Abul Hasan Ali Ibn Moosa Ar-Reza (a).
trans.rurdu: Ay Allah! Yeh 2 rakat namaz meri taraf se hadiya karta hu mere Mawla aur mere Imam, Tera banda aur Tera wali Abul Hasan Ali ibne Moosa Ar-Reza (a) ko.
trans.urdu: اے اللہ! یہ ۲ رکعت نماز میری طرف سے ہدیہ کرتا ہو میرے مولا اور میرے امام، تیرا بندہ اور تیرا ولی ابل حسن علی ابن موسی الرضاؑ کو۔

desc.en: Then after raising the head from prostration one should stand up and facing holy Mashhad make the niyyat of Ziyarat saying: I perform the Ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) on this day of Dahwul Arz on behalf of myself, my parents and all the faithful believing men and believing women to seek the proximity of Almighty Allah.” In Arabic it should be done like this…

arabic.text: اَزُوْرُ سَیِّدِیْ وَمَوْلَایَ وَاِمَامِیْ اَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوْسَی الرِّضَا عَلَیْہِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْبُعْدِ فِیْ مَقَامِیْ ہٰذَا عَنِّیْ وَعَنْ وَالِدَیَّ وَعَنْ جَمِیْعِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لِنَدْبِہَا قُرْبَۃً اِلَی اللہِ۔

lines.rarabic: AZOORO SAYYADEE WA MAWLAAYA WA IMAAMEE ABAL HASANE A’LIY-YIBNE MOOSAR REZAA A’LAIY-HIS SALAAMO A’NIL BO’DE FEE MAQAA-MEE HAAZAA A’NNEE WA A’N WAALE-DAYYA WA A’N JAMEE-I’L MOMENEENA WAL MOMENAATE LE-NADBE-HAA QURBATAN ELAL-LAAH.

trans.rurdu: Mai apne sardaar o mawla o Imam Abul Hasan Ali ibne Moosa (a.s) ki dur apne maqaam se ziyarat karta hu, yeh ziyarat meri aur mere waaledain aur tamaam momeneen o momenaat ki niyaabat mein hai ta-keh Allah ki qurbat haasil ho sakey.
trans.urdu: میں اپنے سردار و مولا و امام ابو الحسن علی ابن موسیٰؑ کی دور اپنے مقام سے زیارت کرتا ہوں، یہ زیارت میری اور میرے والدین اور تمام مومنین و مومنات کی نیابت میں ہے تاکہ اللہ کی قربت حاصل ہو سکے۔
